subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers adopt one of the conflicting fork candidates for this Feishu URL bug, or sponsor a fresh same-repository fix?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but same-repository attempts are closed unmerged and the open fork candidates are conflicting, so automation should pause until maintainers pick the repair path.

options.title: Sponsor fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue one narrow Feishu-plugin fix using the closed and fork PRs as source context, with focused tests and live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt a fork candidate
options.body: Choose the better fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage plus live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep the issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue one narrow Feishu-plugin fix using the closed and fork PRs as source context, with focused tests and live Feishu proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history in the Feishu send/outbound path where this repair belongs.
